Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** see if a letter is associated with current comm log entry
** if it is then enable letter button, else disable it.

 select initcap(description)

 begin

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor cur_comtp (p_comm_type varchar2,
 p_comm_code varchar2) is
 select description
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type = p_comm_type
 and comm_code = p_comm_code 
 and comm_code != 'COMTP'
 --and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id -- IM 10269 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :parameter.p_chapter_id, chapter_id) = :parameter.p_chapter_id -- IM 10269 
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date-1,sysdate); --Added by touqeer for SCR# 16358
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:parameter.p_chapter_id, SYSDATE) BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:parameter.p_chapter_id, SYSDATE) + 1); -- IM 10269

begin
 if :ctrl_block.comm_status = 'NEW' then
 if :don_comm.com_type is null then 
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := null;
 show_error('18015');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 elsif :don_comm.com_type = 'COMTP' then
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := null;
 show_error('18016');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :don_comm.com_type is not null then
 open cur_comtp('COMTP', :don_comm.com_type);
 fetch cur_comtp
 into :don_comm.comm_type_desc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := null;
 show_error('18016');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 if cur_comtp%ISOPEN then
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 :system.message_level := '10';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.01';
 
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.release_version := '01' ;
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.03';
 --:global.release_version := '02'; -- SCR# 16358
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- SCR# 16358
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM 4863 --Removed chapter id condition from valid_parameters
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- International address change
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- IM 5237 (Issues and Timezone changes)
 --:global.program_version := '10'; -- IM 8497
 --:global.program_version := '11'; -- Removed Duplicate Objects
 --:global.program_version := '12'; -- IM 10269 -- 11/13/2014
 --:global.program_version := '13'; -- SCR 21360 (LT2012R3SP3 - SCR 21290) 

 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 -- :global.program_version := '01';
 -- :global.program_version := '02'; --MLT 8299
 :global.program_version := '03'; --MLT 8380
 
 hide_view('comm_details');
 hide_window('pop_window');
 show_view('don_comms');

 /*:parameter.p_donor_id := 'DN00006149';
 :parameter.p_chapter_id := 'WAD';
 :parameter.p_insert_user := 'ADS';
*/

 if :parameter.p_donor_id is null then
 message ('Err: Invalid parameter values passed.', acknowledge);
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 default_value(null, 'global.NOTIF_DIR');
 begin 
 select parameter_value
 into :global.NOTIF_DIR
 from valid_parameters
 where --chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and parameter_code = 'NOTIF_DIR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate +1);
 
 end;
 --:parameter.p_donor_id :='DN30113090';
 :ctrl_block.donor_id := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 set_window_property('don_comms', title, :banner.prog_name || ' [Ver: ' || :global.program_version || '] ' ||
 'Notification Log For - ' || :parameter.p_donor_id);
 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_letter', enabled, property_false);

 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_new', enabled, property_false);
 end if; 
 clear_message; 
 gp_constructor; 
 populate_donors; 

 exception
 when others then 
 show_error('18101');
 exit_form(no_validate);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_COMM_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_comm_details IS

 cursor cur_staffno(p_staff_no varchar2) is
 select rtrim(user_last_name) || ', ' || rtrim(user_first_name)
 from system_users
 where staff_no = p_staff_no 
 and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

 cursor cur_comtp (p_comm_type varchar2,
 p_comm_code varchar2) is
 select description
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type = p_comm_type
 and comm_code = p_comm_code
 --and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id; -- IM 10269 
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :parameter.p_chapter_id, chapter_id) = :parameter.p_chapter_id; -- IM 10269 

BEGIN
 show_window('pop_window');
 show_view('comm_details');

 :don_comm.donor_id := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 --:don_comm.com_date := :donor_communications.com_date;
 :don_comm.com_date := :donor_communications.s_com_date; -- SCR 21360 (LT2012R3SP3 - SCR 21290) 
 :don_comm.com_type := :donor_communications.com_type;
 :don_comm.com_code := :donor_communications.com_code;
 :don_comm.com_desc := :donor_communications.com_desc;
 :don_comm.staff_no := :donor_communications.staff_no;
 :don_comm.action_code := :donor_communications.action_code;
 :don_comm.target_date := :donor_communications.target_date;
 :don_comm.action_date := :donor_communications.action_date;

 set_item_property('don_comm.com_date' , auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_type' , auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_code' , auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_desc' , auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.staff_no' , auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.action_code', auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.target_date', auto_hint, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.action_date', auto_hint, property_false);

 /*
 ** get description for comm type
 */
 if :don_comm.com_type is not null then
 open cur_comtp('COMTP', :don_comm.com_type);
 fetch cur_comtp
 into :don_comm.comm_type_desc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := 'NA';
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 if cur_comtp%ISOPEN then
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 else
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := 'NA';
 end if;

 /*
 ** get description for comm code
 */
 if :don_comm.com_code is not null then
 open cur_comtp(:don_comm.com_type, :don_comm.com_code);
 fetch cur_comtp
 into :don_comm.comm_code_desc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 :don_comm.comm_code_desc := 'NA';
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 if cur_comtp%ISOPEN then
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 else
 :don_comm.comm_code_desc := 'NA';
 end if;

 /*
 ** get description for action code
 */
 if :don_comm.action_code is not null then
 open cur_comtp('ACTCD', :don_comm.action_code);
 fetch cur_comtp
 into :don_comm.action_code_desc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 :don_comm.action_code_desc := 'NA';
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 if cur_comtp%ISOPEN then
 close cur_comtp;
 end if;
 else
 :don_comm.action_code_desc := 'NA';
 end if;

 /* 
 ** get staff name
 */
 if :don_comm.staff_no is not null then
 open cur_staffno(:don_comm.staff_no);
 fetch cur_staffno
 into :don_comm.staff_name;
 if cur_staffno%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_staffno;
 :don_comm.staff_name := '';
 end if;
 if cur_staffno%ISOPEN then
 close cur_staffno;
 end if;
 else
 :don_comm.staff_name := '';
 end if;

 set_block_property('don_comm', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('don_comm', delete_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('don_comm', update_allowed, property_true);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_date' , insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_type' , insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_code' , insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_desc' , insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.staff_no' , insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.action_code', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.target_date', insert_allowed, property_false);

 set_item_property('don_comm.com_date' , update_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_type' , update_allowed, property_false);
 set_item_property('don_comm.com_code' , update_allowed, property_false);

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_donor_info 
 (p_donor_id in varchar2) IS

 szFirstName varchar2(50) := '';
 szMiddleName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastNameSuffix varchar2(50) := '';
 szGender varchar2(6) := '';
 szABODESC varchar2(50) := '';
 szDOB date ;

 cursor cur_donor is
 select a.first_name,
 a.middle_name,
 a.last_name,
 nvl(a.last_name_suffix, ''),
 decode(a.gender, 'M', 'Male', 'F', 'Female', ''), 
 a.date_of_birth,
 b.description
 from donors a, valid_master_codes b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and b.code_type = 'ABO'
 and b.code = nvl(a.blood_type, 'NONE');
 --and a.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

BEGIN
 if p_donor_id is not null then
 open cur_donor;
 fetch cur_donor
 into szFirstName,
 szMiddleName,
 szLastName,
 szLastNameSuffix,
 szGender,
 szDOB,
 szABODESC;
 if cur_donor%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_donor;
 else
 :ctrl_block.donor_name := initcap(szLastName) || ', ' || 
 initcap(szFirstName) || ' ' || 
 initcap(szMiddleName);
 :ctrl_block.donor_sex := initcap(szGender);
 :ctrl_block.donor_dob := to_char(szDOB, 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 :ctrl_block.donor_abo := initcap(substr(szABODESC, 1, 6));
 end if;
 if cur_donor%isopen then
 close cur_donor;
 end if;
 end if;
 --pitss synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_ADDRESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DONOR_ADDRESS 
 (p_donor_id in varchar2) IS

 szStreetName varchar2(50) := '';
 szSuiteApt varchar2(20) := '';
 szCity varchar2(50) := '';
 szState varchar2(2) := '';
 szZip varchar2(5) := '';
 szExtension varchar2(6) := '';
 szAddress varchar2(200):= '';
 p_home_no varchar2(15) := '';
 p_day_ph_no varchar2(20) := '';

 cursor cur_address is
 select a.street_name, a.suite_apt, b.city, b.state, b.zip,
 a.h_area_code || '-' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(a.h_phone_no, 4),
 a.d_area_code || '-' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(a.d_phone_no, 4) , to_char(extension)
 from donor_addresses a, valid_city_state b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and b.usps_id = a.usps_id;
 --and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

BEGIN
 if p_donor_id is not null then
 /*
 ** get donor_address
 */
 open cur_address;
 fetch cur_address
 into szStreetName, szSuiteApt, szCity, szState, szZip, 
 p_home_no, p_day_ph_no, szExtension;
 if cur_address%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_address;
 szAddress := 'Not Available';
 else
 if szExtension is not null then
 p_day_ph_no := p_day_ph_no || ' #' || szExtension;
 end if;
 szAddress := rtrim(szStreetName) || ', ' || nvl(szSuiteApt, '') ||
 ' ' || rtrim(szCity) || ', ' || szState || ' ' || szZip;
 if substr(p_home_no, 1, 1) = '-' then
 p_home_no := p_home_no || ' *';
 end if;
 if substr(p_day_ph_no, 1, 1) = '-' then
 p_day_ph_no := p_day_ph_no || ' *';
 end if;
 end if;
 if cur_address%isopen then
 close cur_address;
 end if;
 end if;
 :ctrl_block.donor_address := szAddress;
 :ctrl_block.donor_home_phone := p_home_no;
 :ctrl_block.donor_work_phone := p_day_ph_no;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INTL_CONTACT_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION INTL_CONTACT_INFO (p_what IN varchar2,
 szDonorID IN donors.donor_id%type,
 szChapterID IN donors.chapter_id%type)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 v_return varchar2(300) :=Null;
 szAddress varchar2(300) := null;
 szHPhoneNumber varchar2(20) := null;
 szExtension varchar2(8) := null;
 szWPhoneNumber varchar2(20) := null;
Begin

 select intl_address_1||decode(intl_address_2,nvl(intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_2||decode(intl_address_3,nvl(intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_3||decode(intl_address_4,nvl(intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 intl_address_4||decode(country_name,nvl(country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 COUNTRY_NAME||decode(intl_postal_code,nvl(intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||INTL_POSTAL_CODE, 
 intl_home_phone_no, intl_work_phone_no, intl_work_phone_ext 
 Into szAddress, szHPhoneNumber, szWPhoneNumber,szExtension
 from donor_addresses 
 where donor_id = szDonorID
 and chapter_id = szChapterID 
 and address_type = 'RES'
 and intl_addr_flag = 'Y';

 
 if p_what = 'ADDR' then
 v_return := szAddress; 
 elsif p_what = 'HOME' then 
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber;
 elsif p_what = 'WORK' and szExtension is not null then
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber||'#'||szExtension; 
 elsif p_what = 'WORK' and szExtension is null then
 v_return := szHPhoneNumber;
 end if; 
 
 Return v_return;
 
Exception when others then handle_error; 
End;
